introduction.title: Performance Optimization in PEGA
introduction.text: Performance optimization is critical for enterprise applications that must handle high user loads, large data volumes, and complex business processes. PEGA provides comprehensive tools and techniques for monitoring, analyzing, and optimizing application performance across all system layers.

summary.title: Key Takeaways
points: Performance monitoring and analysis are essential for identifying optimization opportunities
Database optimization through indexing, query tuning, and connection management provides significant benefits
Application layer optimizations focus on rule efficiency, memory management, and caching
User interface performance directly impacts user experience and adoption
Integration performance requires careful consideration of external dependencies and network latency
Scalability patterns enable applications to handle growth and increased load
Comprehensive performance testing validates optimization efforts and prevents regressions
Following performance best practices from the beginning prevents many common issues
